description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Maester Seymour triggers, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
